subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the 14-action dependency batch be accepted as one supply-chain unit after exact-head checks pass, or should the credential-bearing Codex, app-token, and registry-login updates be split for narrower review and rollback?
rationale: The patch is mechanically correct, but it updates executable dependencies across secret-bearing, security-scanning, and release-publishing workflows, so automation cannot choose the maintainers' desired supply-chain review granularity.

options.title: Accept the grouped batch
options.body: Merge the current exact head after all required checks complete and maintainers confirm the pinned upstream commits.

options.title: Split sensitive actions
options.body: Separate Codex Action, GitHub App token, and Docker login updates from the remaining setup and scanning action bumps for narrower rollback.

options.title: Pause for a stable head
options.body: Wait until Dependabot access and rebase churn stop, then review a stable replacement head.

recommendation.title: Accept the grouped batch
recommendation.body: Merge the current exact head after all required checks complete and maintainers confirm the pinned upstream commits.

likelyOwner.reason: Their history spans the docs agent, action modernization, and repeated hardening of the affected workflow surfaces.
